requirements.original: While signature templates do not allow referencing their parameters directly (e.g. using dot notation), such a reference is possible when modifying a signature template.

requirements.original: However when matching, it shall be applied to optional fields of record and set types only (without restriction on the type of that field). NOTE 1: Can be assigned to templates of any type as a whole or to optional fields of record and set templates.
requirements.canonical: When matching, `omit` SHALL be applied only to optional fields of record and set types, regardless of the type of that field.
requirements.condition: matching is performed

readings: `omit` assigned to a whole template SHALL NOT be used in a matching operation (e.g. receive) at all; it may only be applied when matching optional fields of record and set types.
`omit` assigned to a whole template is allowed and only matches optional fields of record and set types when it is used inside such a template.
ambiguity.issue: "it shall be applied ... only" in combination with NOTE 1 allowing assignment to whole templates leaves open whether matching against a whole template containing `omit` is an error or simply never applies; the restriction reading is chosen.
